Our story

Built by a rider,
for every rider.

Astride was born out of a question every female rider knows but rarely asks aloud: why hasn't anyone built underwear that actually works in the saddle?

We're a UK-based brand designing performance underwear around the real demands of equestrian sport — the bounce, the pressure, the long hours, the white breeches. No compromises. No clinical aesthetics. Just technical engineering that moves with you and protects you, invisibly.

Launching soon. Be the first to know.
